title: Joseph McMoneagle's remote viewing of Soviet bases and the search for General Dozier
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Joseph McMoneagle's remote viewing of Soviet bases and the search for General Dozier, about 1970s-1980s at Soviet Union; Italy, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Joseph mcmonagle mcmonagle used remote viewing to identify Soviet nuclear bases predict key critical events and he even helped locate kidnapped American General James doer

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that Joseph McMoneagle, a remote viewer working for the US government in the 1970s and 80s, used remote viewing, the claimed ability to sense distant places with the mind alone, to identify Soviet nuclear bases and predict key events. Michels adds that McMoneagle even helped locate James Dozier, an American general who had been kidnapped in Italy. If true, it would mean the mind can gather real intelligence across great distances.
